title: Lost Badge Access
description: A fictional access control rehearsal: an employee reports their security badge is lost after working late. The building's access control system shows unusual activity.

cards.title: Lost Badge Report
cards.narrative: It's 11:30 PM. Maria from DevOps calls: she lost her badge after working late. She last had it in the server room at 10:45 PM. Security logs show badge scan at Server Room A at that time, then nothing.

cards.title: Badge Disabled
cards.narrative: You log into the access control system and disable Maria's badge (ID: DEV-4821). All electronic doors immediately reject the badge. Physical security teams are alerted.

cards.title: Reviewing Surveillance
cards.narrative: You pull the server room camera feed. The footage shows Maria entering at 10:45 PM, working at her station, then leaving at 11:15 PM toward the elevator. She appears to have her badge.

cards.title: Location Check
cards.narrative: You verify building access logs. Maria's badge was used at Server Room A (10:45), Elevator B lobby (11:17), and main entrance (11:22). After 11:22, no more scans.

cards.title: Waiting for Employee
cards.narrative: You call Maria. She explains she dropped her badge in the server room parking lot. Security sends a team to retrieve it.

cards.title: Temporary Access
cards.narrative: Since Maria needs immediate access to monitor the overnight build, you issue a temporary badge (TMP-9987) with building-wide access until 9:00 AM. Maria confirms receipt.

cards.title: Lobby Footage
cards.narrative: The lobby cameras show Maria exiting main entrance at 11:22 PM. She walks to her car in the employee lot. No one approaches her. The camera loses sight at the parking lot edge.

cards.title: Parking Lot Search
cards.narrative: Physical security visits the parking lot. They find Maria's car but no badge on the ground. They check the vehicle and find it in the glove compartment. Maria must have placed it there before leaving.

cards.title: Calling Maria
cards.narrative: You call Maria. She's at home, 15 minutes away. She hasn't checked her car yet. You ask her to look in the glove compartment and seat crevices.

cards.title: Assuming Outside
cards.narrative: Since the badge wasn't found in the building and Maria was the last person to have it, you proceed with the standard lost badge protocol: disable the badge, issue temporary access if needed, and schedule a review.

cards.title: Badge Recovered
cards.narrative: Maria finds her badge in the glove compartment. Security reactivates it (DEV-4821). The incident is resolved. You document the false alarm in the security log.
